events.name: Talent Hunt Showcase
events.description: A free platform for talented individuals to showcase their skills. Participate in our nationwide talent hunt and get recognized by industry experts.
events.longDescription: Join thousands of talented participants from across India in our free Talent Hunt Showcase. Whether you excel in singing, dancing, acting, art, sports, or any other skill, this is your chance to shine. Our platform connects you with mentors, industry professionals, and opportunities to take your talent to the next level.

events.name: Intercollege Competitions
events.description: Compete with colleges from across five states in various competitive events. Registration fee applies.
events.longDescription: The Intercollege Competitions bring together the brightest minds from Mumbai, Pune, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka. Participate in multiple categories including sports, academics, arts, cultural events, and technical competitions. Winners receive cash prizes, trophies, and certificates.
